<div class="function-reference" markdown="1">

| Call | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`HAL::displayProxy()`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-hal--displayproxy) | The 128 x 64 screen, for code outside your app's functions. Inside begin(), update() and end(), the starter already calls it `display`. |
| [`display.clear();`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--clear) | Erase the drawing buffer before drawing a frame. |
| [`display.display();`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--display) | Show the drawing buffer on screen. |
| [`display.setColor(WHITE);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--setcolor) | Choose white, black, or inverted pixels for drawing. |
| [`display.setPixel(64, 32);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--setpixel) | Draw one pixel at x, y. |
| [`display.drawLine(0, 0, 40, 20);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--drawline) | Draw a line between two pixel positions. |
| [`display.drawRect(0, 0, 30, 20);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--drawrect) | Draw a rectangle outline; width and height are pixels. |
| [`display.fillRect(0, 0, 30, 20);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--fillrect) | Draw a solid rectangle; width and height are pixels. |
| [`display.drawCircle(64, 32, 10);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--drawcircle) | Draw a circle outline; radius is pixels. |
| [`display.fillCircle(64, 32, 10);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--fillcircle) | Draw a solid circle; radius is pixels. |
| [`display.drawHorizontalLine(0, 0, 20);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--drawhorizontalline) | Draw a horizontal line of the given pixel length. |
| [`display.drawVerticalLine(0, 0, 20);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--drawverticalline) | Draw a vertical line of the given pixel length. |
| [`display.drawTriangle(0, 0, 20, 0, 10, 20);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--drawtriangle) | Join three pixel positions with an outline. |
| [`display.fillTriangle(0, 0, 20, 0, 10, 20);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--filltriangle) | Fill the triangle between three pixel positions. |
| [`display.drawXbm(0, 0, 8, 8, bitmap);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--drawxbm) | Draw a 1-bit bitmap: one on/off bit per pixel, lowest bit first in each byte. |
| [`display.drawProgressBar(0, 0, 60, 8, 50);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--drawprogressbar) | Draw a progress bar; final argument is 0-100 %. |
| [`HAL::clearDisplay();`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-hal--cleardisplay) | Erase the screen drawing buffer. |
| [`HAL::updateDisplay();`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-hal--updatedisplay) | Show the drawing buffer on screen. |
| [`display.drawString(0, 0, "Hi");`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--drawstring) | Draw text using the current font and alignment. Studio apps return 0 on the device and in the browser emulator. |
| [`display.drawStringMaxWidth(0, 0, 80, "Hi");`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--drawstringmaxwidth) | Draw one unwrapped line in studio apps, on the device and in the browser emulator; the width argument is ignored. |
| [`display.getStringWidth("Hi");`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--getstringwidth) | Measure text width in pixels; also accepts text and length. |
| [`display.setFont(ArialMT_Plain_16);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--setfont) | Select a 10, 16, or 24 pixel font handle. |
| [`display.setTextAlignment(TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT);`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-displayproxy--settextalignment) | Place text left, right, or centered on x; CENTER_BOTH also centers on y. |
| [`HAL::drawString(0, 0, "Hi");`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-hal--drawstring) | Draw text at x, y with the current font and alignment. |
| [`BLACK`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-black) | Draw pixels off. |
| [`WHITE`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-white) | Draw pixels on. |
| [`INVERSE`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-inverse) | Toggle drawn pixels on/off. |
| [`ArialMT_Plain_10`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-arialmt-plain-10) | 10 pixel font; pass to setFont(). |
| [`ArialMT_Plain_16`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-arialmt-plain-16) | 16 pixel font; pass to setFont(). |
| [`ArialMT_Plain_24`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-arialmt-plain-24) | 24 pixel font; pass to setFont(). |
| [`TEXT_ALIGN_LEFT`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-text-align-left) | Text starts at x. |
| [`TEXT_ALIGN_RIGHT`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-text-align-right) | Text ends at x. |
| [`TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-text-align-center) | Text is centered on x. |
| [`TEXT_ALIGN_CENTER_BOTH`](../reference/functions.md#symbol-text-align-center-both) | Text is centered on x and y. |
